question: Must the openclaw.ai exact-head Vercel preview pass before this dependency refresh merges, or is the isolated author-access failure acceptable with the existing build and browser proof?
rationale: The patch appears healthy in local and browser validation, but a prior dependency update required rollback after hosted deployment failures and the current production-site preview remains unavailable, so accepting the residual risk requires human deployment ownership.

options.title: Restore hosted preview proof
options.body: Resolve the Vercel author-access requirement, rerun the exact head, and merge only after the openclaw.ai preview succeeds.

options.title: Accept the isolated gate
options.body: Merge using the existing build and browser evidence while explicitly accepting that the production-site preview did not run.

recommendation.title: Restore hosted preview proof
recommendation.body: Resolve the Vercel author-access requirement, rerun the exact head, and merge only after the openclaw.ai preview succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior dependency rollback and validated successful deployments for the restored graph.
